summary_1line: After the war, Vibhishana offers the celestial chariot Pushpaka and hospitality, but Rama declines to delay, eager to return to Bharata and Ayodhya.

image_candidates.scene_text: Vibhishana stands with folded palms before Rama and Lakshmana, presenting the radiant celestial chariot Pushpaka shining like the sun.
The magnificent Pushpaka aerial chariot gleams in the sky, bright as a cloud lit by sunlight, ready to carry Rama back to Ayodhya.
Rama gently refuses Vibhishana’s hospitality, speaking earnestly before gathered monkeys and titans while expressing longing to see Bharata.
